name: bytes_round_trip
comment: A bytes property (ADR-0040 add.1, UserProfile.Avatar) writes and reads back byte for byte through insert, a column-list update, and a full update. The values are the ones text binding breaks: a NUL byte, a backslash, 0xff and an invalid UTF-8 sequence (AFz/J0HDKAo= is 00 5c ff 27 41 c3 28 0a), then bytes that spell a bytea escape literal (XHg0MVxcAA== is the text \x41\\ followed by NUL) — escaped-text binding would read them back as 'A'. A full update writing null clears the column.
